      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Whether the combination of MEMPOOL_NO_BROADCAST on wallet loading and MEMPOOL_AND_BROADCAST_ADDED on rebroadcast could prevent a transaction from being resubmitted if the node was offline during a mempool spike that purged the transaction from the network",
      "quote": "The only open question I have at the moment is whether the combination of using `MEMPOOL_NO_BROADCAST` on wallet loading and then `MEMPOOL_AND_BROADCAST_ADDED` on the wallet’s rebroadcast could preven",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "fametrano confirmed with regtest tests that transactions retained in the local mempool are not reannounced after restart; vasild also confirmed the scenario",

      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Extend test_resubmit_on_load past the first periodic resubmission to pin the intended rebroadcast behaviour",
      "quote": "test_resubmit_on_load stops before the first periodic resubmission; extending it would pin whichever behaviour is intended.",

      "text": "The test assertions in test_resubmit_on_load check txids against invs which contain wtxids, so they never fail",

      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "vasild investigated and suggested checking that neither txid nor wtxid are in invs",

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Assert that txid is not in peer_second's invs since neither txid nor wtxid should be present",

      "text": "Determine the feerate of the transaction to be evicted dynamically instead of hardcoding 30 in evict_mempool_transaction",

      "quote": "Adding a separate option to disable rebroadcast, ideally off by default, would be useful. That way, it's opt-in for advanced users who need it.",
